beta.note: Legacy Scale/e-paper Beta artifacts may exist, but Beta is not part of the coordinated signed release contract and no Touch Beta feed is published.

documentation_contract.epaper_pairing: The e-paper display generates a temporary six-digit code during an explicit five-minute Scale pairing window.
documentation_contract.epaper_wake: GPIO12 capacitive touch is armed with either the optional 180-second periodic check-in or the 3600-second safety timer.
documentation_contract.touch_pairing: The Wi-Fi touchscreen uses a six-character hexadecimal pairing code with controller protocol 1.
documentation_contract.touch_power: The Wi-Fi touchscreen is an externally powered always-awake controller.
documentation_contract.beta_policy: Production and Development are supported coordinated channels. Beta is legacy/unpublished for coordinated releases until a Touch Beta feed is intentionally added.
